EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
Notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk1A

FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE MEMBER OF THEKANDY MUNICIPAL COUNCILUNDER SECTION 65A(2) OF THELOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 262)AS AMENDED BYLOCAL AUTHORITIES (SPECIAL PROVISIONS) ACT, No. 30 OF 2013
WHEREAS the office of a member in Kandy Municipal Council has fallen vacant by reason of Resignation ;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the recognized political party namely United National Party, to which the formermember Mr. Neranjan Priyadarshana Wijayarathne belonged, was required by me under Section 65A(2) of the aforesaidOrdinance, to nominate within a period of thirty (30) days a person eligible under the ordinance for election as a member ofthat Kandy Municipal Council who shall be declared elected as a member ;
AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has nominated Mr. Mohomed MuththalibShiraj Hassan being an eligible person under the aforesaid Ordinance to fill such vacancy ;

NOW THEREFORE I, Thalangama Appuhamilage Chaminda Namal Thalangama, Returning Officer of KandyMunicipal Council, acting in terms of Section 65A(2) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance as amended by Filling ofVacancies in Local Authorities (Special Provisions) Act, No. 30 of 2013 (Chapter 262) do hereby declare Mr. MohomedMuththalib Shiraj Hassan elected as a member of the Kandy Municipal Council.
T. A. C. N. THALANGAMA,Returning Officer,Kandy Municipal Council.District Elections Office,Kandy,14th of July, 2015.
